1_architecture.summary: Fully client-side React Native (Expo SDK 55, Router v6, New Architecture). Offline-first SQLite with AES-256-GCM encryption for sensitive data. No backend server — all computation on-device.

stack.database: expo-sqlite (SQLite, schema v20, 51 tables, WAL mode)

2_system_health_scores.methodology: 0-100 per dimension. Based on verified code reads, CI pipeline results, and architecture analysis.

type_safety.rationale: tsc --noEmit EXIT 0 with strict: true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true. Zod validation at boundaries. 8 points deducted for: ~233 no-explicit-any ESLint warnings (eslint-disable comments used in several places), and occasional `as any` casts in RevenueCat/health adapter integrations.

test_coverage.rationale: 43 test files, 807 tests pass, 0 fail. But: only ~64% of services tested (27/42), ~45% of engines tested (14/31), 25+ services have zero test files, zero integration tests for screens/navigation, no E2E tests. FitMind, health adapters, and backup services are untested. Score reflects passing tests vs total surface area.

code_quality.rationale: 804 ESLint warnings ratcheted (275 no-unused-vars, 237 no-console, 233 no-explicit-any, 58 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps, 1 react-native/no-raw-text). Prettier enforced. No ESLint errors. Points deducted for: unused variables proliferation, 30+ setTimeout/setInterval usages in app screens (some are legitimate timers, some are timing hacks), silent .catch(() => {}) patterns in 20+ places (swallows errors).

security.rationale: AES-256-GCM v3 encryption for health/AI data, PBKDF2-SHA256 100k iterations for passcodes, biometric auth with 5-attempt lockout, rate limiting on auth/AI/destructive ops, log redaction for sensitive keys, 24h offline grace with clock tamper detection. Points deducted for: AI API keys in EXPO_PUBLIC_ env vars (client-extractable), no certificate pinning, no runtime integrity checks (root/jailbreak detection), Health Connect feature flag disabled (ff_health_sync = false).

architecture.rationale: Clean separation: engines (algorithmic) vs services (orchestration) vs context (React state). Singleton patterns with getInstance(). SystemGuard state machine for boot. WriteFirewall for data integrity. DatabaseLifecycle for self-healing. Points deducted for: 10 providers deep (nesting risk), Apollo Client still in dependencies (dead weight), some screens exceed 1500+ lines (fitquest.tsx, dashboard.tsx), timing dependencies in splash/login screens.

performance.rationale: SQLite WAL mode, LRU query cache, memoized tab bar and screen options, lazy screen loading, Reanimated 4 with worklets. Points deducted for: no bundle size analysis, no startup time benchmarks, 30+ setTimeout calls in screens suggesting timing workarounds, no performance profiling data, ComputationCache exists but unclear if all expensive calculations use it.

reliability.rationale: ErrorBoundary at root, ScreenErrorBoundary per screen, SystemGuard BOOTING→READY state machine, WAL for durability, snapshot/backup services, database integrity validation + auto-repair. Points deducted for: 20+ silent catch blocks (.catch(() => {})), no retry logic for failed database operations (WAL marks failed but doesn't retry), Health Connect disabled due to crashes, no circuit breaker for AI provider failures.

maintainability.rationale: Strong TypeScript typing, modular file organization, clear naming conventions. Points deducted for: schema.ts at 1700 lines (migration logic is monolithic), service.ts at 2893 lines, several screens over 1000 lines, 25+ services with no tests make refactoring risky, SCHEMA_VERSION managed manually across files.

2_system_health_scores.composite_formula: Weighted average: type_safety(15%) + test_coverage(20%) + code_quality(10%) + security(15%) + architecture(10%) + performance(10%) + reliability(10%) + maintainability(10%)
2_system_health_scores.verdict: SOLID FOUNDATION — mature enough for a controlled beta/soft launch with known gaps documented. Not ready for unrestricted production at scale without addressing test coverage and reliability gaps.

current_state.model: Freemium with 14-day trial → monthly ($5.39) / annual ($53.99, 17% savings)
current_state.gate_mechanism: PremiumGate component wraps 5 screens. AccessState machine: RESOLVING→spinner, TRIAL_ACTIVE/SUBSCRIBED→render, EXPIRED→paywall redirect.
current_state.enforcement_status: ACTIVE — PremiumGate properly enforced, SubscriptionContext derives state from SubscriptionManager dynamically

strengths: RevenueCat handles receipt validation, renewal, and platform differences
Paywall screen is custom-built with feature highlights and plan comparison
Trial state persisted in SQLite with explicit state machine
Grace period prevents false lockouts during network issues
gaps: No A/B testing on paywall design or pricing
No win-back flow for churned subscribers
No promotional offer support (introductory pricing, free trials via RevenueCat)
No in-app messaging for trial countdown urgency (days 10-14)
RevenueCat UI package imported but unused (custom paywall only)
revenue_risks: All 5 gated screens are intelligence/premium features — free tier includes workouts, exercises, steps, profile. Users may never hit the gate if they only use core features.
14-day trial may be too generous — users can extract full value before converting
No server-side receipt validation beyond RevenueCat — if RevenueCat goes down, grace period is only fallback
AI features require API keys which cost money per query — no usage cap per tier

encryption.migration: Auto-migrates v1 (XOR) → v2 (CTR+HMAC) → v3 (GCM) on read
encryption.assessment: STRONG — industry-standard encryption, proper key management, no plaintext health data

authentication.lockout: 5 attempts → exponential backoff, 15 failures → emergency wipe
authentication.rate_limiting: Per-action rate limits (biometric: 5/60s, passcode: 10/5min, AI: 30/5min, destructive: 1/10min)
authentication.assessment: STRONG — defense in depth with multiple layers

data_protection.log_redaction: Sensitive key patterns auto-redacted (token, secret, password, key, session, biometric, receipt)
data_protection.no_async_storage: All storage via SecureStore or SQLite (no plaintext AsyncStorage)
data_protection.write_firewall: Exercise writes validated and deduplicated before DB insert

HIGH.title: AI API keys exposed in client bundle
HIGH.detail: EXPO_PUBLIC_GROK_API_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_GROQ_API_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENROUTER_API_KEY are compiled into the JS bundle. Any user can extract these via reverse engineering.
HIGH.impact: API key theft → billing abuse, unauthorized AI usage
HIGH.fix: Proxy AI calls through a backend API with user authentication

HIGH.title: No root/jailbreak detection
HIGH.detail: App runs on rooted/jailbroken devices without restriction. SQLite database is accessible to other processes on rooted devices.
HIGH.fix: Add expo-device or custom native module for root detection, warn or restrict on compromised devices

MEDIUM.title: No certificate pinning
MEDIUM.detail: Network calls to PostHog, Sentry, RevenueCat, and AI providers use default TLS without certificate pinning.
MEDIUM.fix: Implement certificate pinning for critical endpoints (RevenueCat, AI providers)

MEDIUM.title: Silent error swallowing in 20+ locations
MEDIUM.detail: .catch(() => {}) in service.ts, engines, and AI provider. Failed operations are not logged or retried.
MEDIUM.impact: Data loss goes undetected, security events may be missed
MEDIUM.fix: Replace silent catches with error telemetry logging

MEDIUM.title: Health Connect disabled due to crashes
MEDIUM.detail: Feature flag ff_health_sync = false. Health Connect adapter exists but is not activated.
MEDIUM.impact: Android health data integration is non-functional
MEDIUM.fix: Debug Health Connect crashes, enable with proper error boundaries

LOW.title: Apollo Client dead dependency
LOW.detail: Apollo Client is imported but SQLite is the sole data source. Unused dependency increases attack surface.
LOW.impact: Unused code in bundle, potential supply chain risk

LOW.title: PostHog session replay on native
LOW.detail: Session replay captures screen content which may include health data.
LOW.impact: Health data may be transmitted to PostHog servers
LOW.fix: Ensure session replay masking is configured for health screens

critical_missing_features.title: No backend server
critical_missing_features.impact: No cross-device sync, no remote config, no server-side analytics, no push notifications targeting, no A/B testing, no user account recovery
critical_missing_features.workaround: Cloud backup to Cloudflare Workers (optional, requires EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKUP_API_BASE_URL)

critical_missing_features.title: Health Connect integration disabled
critical_missing_features.impact: Android users cannot sync steps, heart rate, sleep from Google Fit / Samsung Health
critical_missing_features.workaround: Manual data entry, pedometer via expo-sensors

critical_missing_features.title: No push notifications
critical_missing_features.impact: Cannot remind users of workouts, trial expiry, streak maintenance
critical_missing_features.workaround: expo-notifications plugin configured but no notification scheduling logic found

critical_missing_features.title: No exercise video/animation content
critical_missing_features.impact: Users rely on text instructions only, poor UX for beginners
critical_missing_features.workaround: exerciseImageService.ts exists, audio guidance via TTS

retention_gaps: No push notification reminders for workout streaks
No streak recovery mechanism (broken streak = reset to 0)
No gamification beyond XP (no badges, achievements, levels beyond numeric XP)
No onboarding completion tracking or re-engagement for dropoff users
No workout variety suggestions based on user fatigue/boredom detection
growth_gaps: No deep linking for sharing workouts
No App Store Optimization (ASO) metadata in app.config.ts
No review/rating prompt at positive moments
No user testimonials or community proof in paywall

SHOULD fix: Enable Health Connect with proper error handling (major Android feature gap)
SHOULD fix: Add push notification scheduling for streak reminders and trial expiry
SHOULD fix: Audit 58 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings for stale closure bugs

hard_blockers: AI API keys in client bundle (SEC-H1) — if AI features ship, this is a billing exposure
soft_blockers: Health Connect disabled — limits Android health integration
48% test coverage — high risk of regression on changes

ready_for.production_launch: CONDITIONAL — fix SEC-H1, enable Health Connect, add push notifications
